messages:
sophie r: heads up - CI flagged both SAST and DAST flows failing on nightly run. Looks like an auth error during artifact pull & scanning.

tom h: paste the failing step?

sophie r: GHA output: ```ERROR: artifact download failed: PermissionDenied: Service account 'scanners@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' cannot call cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecryption on projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra-keyring/cryptoKeys/infra-key (403)```

devops-bot: Deploy webhook: nightly-security-scan started for refs/heads/main (run_id: 6321)

nina p: that's odd - we've had infra-key bindings stable. Did anyone touch the runner impersonation mapping in infra-config?

tom h: I pushed the runner-refactor PR yesterday (PR #4980) to consolidate runner profiles. It changed default impersonation fallback for scheduled jobs to use scanners@ instead of infra-ci@. I assumed scanners@ had proper keys but maybe not.

sophie r: quick triage suggestion: 1) confirm which SA the action is using, 2) check KMS key IAM, 3) temporary mitigation: ephemeral grant or switch runner to infra-ci@.

security-bot: :rotating_light: incident created: SEC-KMS-1746123456 

tom h: checking GHA logs: runner set to use serviceAccount:scanners@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com (line 204).

nina p: running get-iam-policy: ```gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy infra-key --keyring=infra-keyring --location=global --project=redwood-prod --format=json``` shows only infra-ci@ and deploy-bot@ in encrypter/decrypter binding. scanners@ missing.

sophie r: ok that explains it. Why did scanners@ previously work in nightly runs? Any chance of key rotation that introduced key version constraints?

tom h: no rotation. My PR changed which SA is used for scheduled runs. I reverted the PR to fallback infra-ci@ for now. Rerunning nightly.

devops-bot: nightly-security-scan rerun queued (run_id: 6322)

sophie r: rerun shows SAST passed but DAST failed during auth to staging app endpoint (401) — looks like the DAST runner uses a short-lived token minted by infra-poller and that service account's token exchange failed earlier in the flow.

nina p: this is getting multi-faceted: 1) KMS binding gap for scanners@, 2) token exchange for infra-poller, 3) our scanning orchestration masks KMS errors as generic auth failures.

tom h: for immediate mitigation I granted scanners@ the encrypter/decrypter role on infra-key (ephemeral, 2h) and restarted the run. DAST now progresses further.

sophie r: good. For RCA and follow-ups: we should update SDLC security review to include a checklist item: "runner SA changes require explicit KMS binding verification and audit log evidence." Add a pre-merge CI check that verifies any PR that modifies runner impersonation or schedules includes a mapping file and a test verifying key access.

nina p: propose a new guardrail: a log-based alert on SetIamPolicy for any of our infra KMS keys that notifies security and infra (pager duty). Also add a periodic job that checks expected SA bindings (from a canonical mapping in infra-repo) vs actual bindings, create PRs to reconcile drift.

tom h: agree. I'll draft a GH Action that runs during PRs touching infra-config/* and runs: ```gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy infra-key --project=redwood-prod --format=json | jq '.bindings'``` and then compare against infra-config/expected-kms-bindings.json. If mismatch, fail the PR with instructions.

sophie r: add two more items: 1) improve scanner error surfacing so KMS/403 vs token-exchange/401 are explicit in the log and linked to incident runbook, 2) update vulnerability triage workflow: when scanning fails due to infra/auth, mark findings as TOOLS-FAIL and re-scan once infra is resolved so we don't create noisy vuln tickets.

security-bot: Incident SEC-KMS-1746123456 assigned to tom h, severity P2 — https://incidents.redwood.ai/1746123456

nina p: I'll own the alert and reconciliation job. Sophie, can you add the SDLC checklist change to the security review template? We should include a short how-to for ephemeral grants and an example `gcloud` command.

sophie r: added template edit in PR #4992 (sd lc: add KMS check). Example ephemeral grant snippet: ```gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding infra-key --keyring=infra-keyring --location=global --member=serviceAccount:scanners@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter --condition=None``` (note: replace with time-limited token flow in docs).

tom h: followups I'm filing: INFRA-814 (PR lint for KMS bindings), INFRA-815 (runner -> SA canonical mapping doc + tests), SEC-529 (log alert + runbook), TOOLS-120 (scanner error handling).

sophie r: quick note for vuln triage leads: if you see TOOLS-FAIL, don't start remediation until a successful re-scan confirms the finding. Add TTL of 72h for auto-close if no re-scan, escalate to infra if persistent.

nina p: thanks. Also worth auditing recent RBAC PRs for other accidental SA fallback changes. I'll run a grep across infra history.

tom h: thanks all. Revert and ephemeral grant fixed the pipeline quickly. We'll track follow-ups and aim to have the PR lint in place before next release. :thumbsup:
